method: local CPU inference; no reference upload

coordinates.normalized: x pixel / width, y pixel / height; origin top-left
coordinates.depth: MediaPipe z: smaller = nearer camera; roughly x-normalized scale; not metric
coordinates.semantic_sides: image left and image right; no assumption about photograph mirroring

measurements.valid_for_anatomical_comparison: near-front only; profile values are foreshortened

reliability_notes: No per-landmark confidence is exposed by this FaceMesh interface.
Presence of 478 points does not make hidden-side predictions observed evidence.
Landmark 10 marks a forehead oval, not the hairline or the top of the skull.
Contour points on oblique views are projected model locations, not a traced visible silhouette.
